list.name: site_id
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_name AS __text, site_id AS __value FROM analytics.v_grafana_sites WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} ORDER BY site_name
list.definition: SELECT site_name AS __text, site_id AS __value FROM analytics.v_grafana_sites WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} ORDER BY site_name

list.name: asset_ids
list.label: Assets
list.query: SELECT hierarchy_path AS __text, asset_id AS __value FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND site_id::text = '$site_id' ORDER BY hierarchy_path
list.definition: SELECT hierarchy_path AS __text, asset_id AS __value FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND site_id::text = '$site_id' ORDER BY hierarchy_path

list.name: logical_point_id
list.label: Data point
list.query: SELECT logical_point||COALESCE(' ['||unit_symbol||']','') AS __text, logical_point_id AS __value FROM analytics.v_grafana_point_catalog WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND site_id::text = '$site_id' GROUP BY logical_point,unit_symbol,logical_point_id ORDER BY logical_point
list.definition: SELECT logical_point||COALESCE(' ['||unit_symbol||']','') AS __text, logical_point_id AS __value FROM analytics.v_grafana_point_catalog WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND site_id::text = '$site_id' GROUP BY logical_point,unit_symbol,logical_point_id ORDER BY logical_point

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS time,COALESCE(asset_name,device_name)||' · '||logical_point AS metric,numeric_value FROM analytics.v_grafana_normalized_points np LEFT JOIN analytics.v_grafana_assets a ON a.grafana_org_id=np.grafana_org_id AND a.asset_id=np.asset_id LEFT JOIN analytics.v_grafana_devices d ON d.grafana_org_id=np.grafana_org_id AND d.device_id=np.device_id WHERE np.grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND np.site_id::text = '$site_id' AND ('${asset_ids:raw}' = '__all' OR np.asset_id::text IN (${asset_ids:sqlstring})) AND ('${logical_point_id:raw}' = '__all' OR np.logical_point_id::text IN (${logical_point_id:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time

SELECT logical_point,unit_symbol,count(*) AS samples,min(numeric_value) AS minimum,avg(numeric_value) AS average,max(numeric_value) AS maximum,min(event_time) AS first_sample,max(event_time) AS last_sample FROM analytics.v_grafana_normalized_points WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND site_id::text = '$site_id' AND ('${asset_ids:raw}' = '__all' OR asset_id::text IN (${asset_ids:sqlstring})) AND ('${logical_point_id:raw}' = '__all' OR logical_point_id::text IN (${logical_point_id:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY logical_point,unit_symbol ORDER BY logical_point

SELECT logical_point,unit_symbol,data_type,recommended_aggregation,count(DISTINCT asset_id) AS assets,count(DISTINCT device_id) AS devices FROM analytics.v_grafana_point_catalog WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND site_id::text = '$site_id' GROUP BY logical_point,unit_symbol,data_type,recommended_aggregation ORDER BY logical_point
